_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA bench, 5.2 long x 2.1 deep x 3.6 tall, seat top 1.9. Origin on the floor under the middle; you sit facing +Y here (Roblox -Z after the usual lookAt). Suggested: pairs facing the centre along the left and right edges, e.g. hub (+-50, 0, 10) and (+-50, 0, 30), with a planter between each pair. Textures: the shared Hub_CleanProps_* 512 set (lamp, bench and planter use the same three maps).

CleanBench_Body.note: white arm panels with sky knobs, two grey rails

seatTop.note: top of the seat cushion, for a Seat part 4 x 0.4 x 1.8
